title: [dev-e]  Medtrum - Hide pump expiry warning when patch expiration is disabled
body:
With the medtrum pump, when Patch Expiration is turned off in the medtrum settings, the setting/line for "Pump expiry warning [hours]" is still marked as active, but nonresponsive. It would be a slight improvement to gray out/hide this setting when pump expiry is disabled
